svg.text: DENTAL PATIENT–STUDENT MATCHING APP | FULL DATABASE SCHEMA
Comprehensive 24-Entity Relational Model matching Refrences/schema (1).png, Chen ERDs & BACKEND_SYSTEM_PLAN_2.md
System Architecture & Workflow Rules Grounded in Relational Schema:
1. Role Segregation (4 Roles): Patients submit cases with medical history; Students take cases; Supervisors approve their students' cases; Admins approve accounts.
2. Supervisor ID Matching: Upon admin approval, supervisor receives unique permanent code (e.g. 4, 7, SUP-0001); student registration enforces valid supervisor_id link.
3. Medical Safety & Privacy: Patient names and contact info remain hidden until patient confirms appointment; fixed medical questionnaire drives automatic risk flags.
4. Portfolio & Mentions: Before/After treatment photos appear in public portfolio and patient history ONLY with explicit patient consent and supervisor validation.
